_about: laneWHIRLFIX FeetClip (-feetclip:<dir>, Assets/Scripts/FeetClip.cs). Measuring only, dark: nothing happens without the flag. REAL game speed (no captureFramerate, camera rig live), Joan walks toward Pitborn (approachSec), then round him at orbitRadiusM (orbitSec), then stands (holdSec; the steady-camera part is the one to score). Region = fixed screen rectangle as fractions of the screen, origin top-left (default: the floor band holding both pairs of feet); video = whole frame downscaled. flipY: set true if first_full.png comes out upside down.
